study: Photographic 2x super-resolution. Compare teacher headroom, an exact block-mean correction, and training only the unmeasured within-block detail.
grouping: Parse the Flickr account slug and photo ID in the archive attribution. Keep one photo per account by salted SHA256 rank of the member path. Order accounts by separately salted SHA256 rank. Reject shared IDs across accounts or repeated selected pixel tensors. Use the first 600 accounts for training, next 128 for A, next 128 for B, next 256 reserved for C. Remaining accounts unused. No image scores inform this allocation.
images: Convert to luminance, center-square crop and Lanczos resize to 64x64, divide by 255. A photograph is the unit. Training uses fresh uniform 32x32 crops. Evaluate the entire 64x64 photo. No class labels used in fitting or selection.
measurement: Exact arithmetic mean of each non-overlapping 2x2 block; repeat nearest to input the shared single-channel U-Net. Stress check adds independent Gaussian noise of SD 0.05 to each low-resolution mean, without input clipping. Do not fit or tune for this stress check.
timing: One PyTorch CPU thread. Warm disposable models before measurement. Exclude model setup, warm-up, snapshots, evaluation and disk IO. Include crop sampling, forward, MSE, backward and Adam update. Stop at the first completed step at or beyond 14 seconds. Alternate wide-first and small-first across the six training seeds. Require the two timed widths to fall within 2% wall time of each other per seed. Record all stopping steps for exact-step replay. This compares stand-alone training budgets, not a full distillation pipeline.
phase_3: Fit a wide supervised teacher and ordinary small supervised U-Net. Report nearest, bicubic, small at 240 steps, small at equal wall time, and teacher. Primary headroom contrast uses the same exact postprocessing for both models, ensuring any remaining difference is due to within-block detail. Also report raw predictions and bounded-display sensitivity. For A and B separately, measure Spearman correlation across photos between teacher PSNR gain and absolute first-difference MAE reduction, after averaging the paired gains over seeds. Across train-defined tertiles of clean photo gradient magnitude, report which tertile has the highest average headroom in A and whether the same tertile leads in B; descriptive only.
math_diagnostics: For exact and noisy means compare the same small model with and without the orthogonal mean correction. On each photo test the squared-error decomposition, and that the correction leaves the within-block residual unchanged. Construct an ambiguous photo by swapping adjacent columns inside each block; examine exact integer block sums and both-label minimum average MSE. Verify with float64 autograd that, for a projected prediction under MSE, imitating a full fixed teacher or only its within-block detail gives the same student gradient.
independent_alternative: After phase 3 train the same small model with the block-mean correction inside the MSE. The baseline trained full-image MSE. Both use identical initialization, crops, optimizer and the same correction at inference. Compare after 240 steps, at the baseline's timed step count (matched updates), and at equal measured 14 s (matched wall time). Report all. Advancement requires passing both long comparisons on both A and B. A/B are shared development cohorts; this is a prespecified separate hypothesis even if the teacher stops.
metrics: PSNR is the mean of per-photo -10 log10 float-space MSE (peak 1). Detail metric is mean absolute error in horizontal/vertical first differences. Both use the raw real-valued reconstruction; a separate PSNR after clipping both predictions to [0,1] is a display sensitivity. The null-space MSE removes the 2x2 block means from the prediction error. Bootstrap the same photos for both arms and all training seeds; interval is conditional on the fitted seeds.
decision: For each quality comparison separately on A and B require average gain >=0.10 dB, positive PSNR in every training seed, and average gradient MAE no more than 1% worse. For teacher qualification also require positive gains over the projected short student for all seeds, photo-gain Spearman >=0.25 on both halves, and valid timed comparisons. If qualified, freeze one distinct teaching mechanism before a single evaluation on new C accounts, with plain, ordinary KD, matched randomized and equal-time controls. Otherwise stop this teacher route. If the independent training alternative qualifies, evaluate it once on C. If both qualify, include both in the same frozen C evaluation. C remains unscored if neither qualifies. No significance or novelty claim.
